name: Iwamuro (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Iwamuro village emblem in white: a ring open at the top beneath a winged device with a pointed top.
history: Flag of the former village of Iwamuro in Niigata Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-03-21.

features.role: Iwamuro village emblem — a ring open at the top beneath a winged device with a pointed top
